usedFor: Calendly collects an email from each person who books; ClearBounce checks whether it is real. A booking in Calendly can send that address to ClearBounce with “Verify Email Address”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting Book or Invitee Created” in Calendly, then “Verify Email Address” in ClearBounce
bestTemplate.why: It checks each invitee's address as they book, so a typo or fake email gets caught before it enters your follow-up list.

watchOut: “Create Bulk Job” starts a job for a list of addresses, so one booking gives it a single-address list. “Verify Email Address” is the one that fits a single invitee.
